Roadmap refinement 2026-09-13: release requires current successful/explicitly dispositioned evidence for PHRF-09/12 repairs, PHRF-21 condition requalification, PHRF-32 trial laws, PHRF-29/11 integration, PHRF-33 complete B0 decision, PHRF-14 calibration and PHRF-15 repeated performance. The dependency graph reaches these through PHRF-14/15/21.

Check evidence content and exact source/provider/runtime revisions, not only closed statuses. Run warning-clean scalafimCompileAll and required JVM/JS tests in bounded batches; retain a runnable downstream workflow plus actual exported trial/condition/query identity and unit checks. Update current plan/work-item docs so the adopted v2 header no longer says draft/not applied or lacks assigned handles; mark v1 as historical and link final acceptance evidence.

Keep PHRF-23/24/30/31 optional unless an explicit recorded decision promotes a scope. PHRF-10 remains provisional/deferred pending PHRF-33; if the checkpoint activates finite-state work, add its required release dependencies before recording release eligibility. Publication is separate: this planning request does not authorize pushing e071e83 or a later commit.

---
Prior implementation criteria retained for traceability (the dated scope clarification above governs where it differs):

Closes when PHRF-14, PHRF-15 and PHRF-21 have evidence for `CompactCondition`
and `TrialBanded`. Finite-state, readout fields, stimulus features and
voxelwise AR remain visible optional work and do not block release.

Revision 2 (2026-09-10): docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items-v2.md; review: docs/plans/profile-hrf-review.md; spike evidence: docs/plans/profile-hrf-spike-results.md; scientific plan: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md.
